picker.title: Find thermometer
picker.explain: JoyoFit will scan nearby Bluetooth devices to find your thermometer. Scan results are only used on this phone.
picker.hint: Hold your phone close to the thermometer. Thermometers JoyoFit can read show up with their temperature.
picker.none: Nothing in sight yet. Make sure your phone's Bluetooth is on and the thermometer is close.
picker.unreadable: Stock Xiaomi firmware: its numbers are not broadcast openly. Pick a way below, or flash the community firmware.

firmware.title: What the thermometer needs
firmware.body: JoyoFit reads a Xiaomi LYWSD03MMC (and the similar MHO-C401, CGG1) in three ways. Community firmware pvvx/ATC_MiThermometer (ATC1441, PVVX custom, BTHome v2): from its broadcasts, without connecting. Stock Xiaomi firmware: its broadcasts are encrypted with a bind key Xiaomi holds, so JoyoFit can open them if you enter that bind key, or it connects briefly every 10 minutes while the app is open, without a key. The community firmware is flashed from a browser over Bluetooth; check the hardware version first, units sold since March 2025 (B1.5 and B1.6) are not recommended by the firmware author.

night.title: Watch overnight
night.explain: One reading every 5 minutes is kept on this phone. The night's average is only sent to Sleep insights if you turn it on.
night.ios: iPhone limits Bluetooth scanning in the background, so JoyoFit only reads the thermometer while the app is open. A night's average only builds up if JoyoFit stays open all night.
night.oldBuild: Overnight watching needs an app update from the store, not a quick update. Until then JoyoFit only reads the thermometer while the app is open.
night.autoHint: When you open JoyoFit between 7 PM and the morning, watching starts by itself. A notification stays up while it runs.
night.gatt: This thermometer is read over a connection, only while JoyoFit is open. To watch overnight, use a bind key.
night.oldBuildKey: Overnight watching with a bind key needs an app update from the store, not a quick update. Until then JoyoFit only reads the thermometer while the app is open.

privacy.title: Your room data
privacy.body: Raw readings stay on this phone and are deleted after 120 days. All that can leave the phone is the average temperature and humidity per night (mean, lowest, highest and number of readings), and only when Sleep insights is on in More, Connections, JoyoRogo. A night with too few readings sends no room data.

notification.title: Watching the room temperature
notification.text: JoyoFit is listening to your room thermometer until morning.

key.label: Bind key (32 hexadecimal digits)
key.invalid: That is not a bind key. A bind key is 32 hexadecimal digits (0-9 and a-f).
key.wrongKey: This bind key does not belong to this thermometer: its broadcasts do not open with it. Check it again, a single wrong digit fails.
key.noFrames: No broadcast to check against yet. Bring your phone close to the thermometer, wait a few seconds, and try again.
key.unsupported: This thermometer uses an old MiBeacon version (24 digit key) or leaves out its address, which is not supported yet. Try Connect directly.

help.title: How to get the bind key
help.where: Xiaomi makes the bind key when the thermometer is added in Mi Home / Xiaomi Home. Only you hold it, and you can get it in one of two ways:
help.extractor: 1. Xiaomi Cloud Tokens Extractor: a script on a computer. Sign in with your Xiaomi account and it lists each device's BLE key. It changes nothing on the thermometer.
help.flasher: 2. Telink Flasher (in Chrome, over Bluetooth): connect the thermometer and choose Get Mi Bind Key.
help.warning: Telink Flasher unpairs the thermometer from Mi Home. Afterwards Mi Home no longer shows it; if you add it again, Xiaomi makes a new bind key and the one saved in JoyoFit stops working.
help.privacy: The bind key is a secret. JoyoFit keeps it only in this phone's Keychain / Keystore and never writes it to the log, sends it or syncs it.

compare.title: Which one fits?
compare.direct: Connect directly: no key. JoyoFit connects for a few seconds every 10 minutes while the app is open, then lets go. It does not run overnight, and while it is connected Mi Home cannot read the thermometer.
compare.bindkey: Use bind key: JoyoFit only listens to broadcasts and never connects, so Mi Home keeps working. It also runs overnight with the store app. You need the bind key from the steps above.
